ruleDefinitions.name: MacOS Scripting Interpreter AppleScript
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of AppleScript of the macOS scripting language AppleScript.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\/osascript$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-e\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.scpt.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\.js.*")))
